latest_final:
The father is himself the hostage being held by the kidnapper. The kidnapper phones the daughter and demands that she bring one hundred million yen alone by noon or the hostage — her father — will be killed.

The father decides the ransom should not be paid because the payment would require his daughter to come alone into the kidnapper's hands. He believes that if she did so, the kidnapper would not simply release him: the money would not free him, and the daughter would also be seized or harmed. His refusal is thus primarily aimed at protecting his daughter from being lured into the kidnapper's trap, even at the risk of his own life.
